name: Ethan Miller
psychographics: Resents the erosion of personal choice; believes convenience should not require surrendering data.
current_solutions: Orders coffee by speaking to the barista; pays with cash or a physical gift card; uses no food-delivery apps.
frustration: Tried to order a takeaway lunch at 1:30pm via the restaurant's website; the page timed out after the payment screen loaded, and the system demanded a phone number she did not want to give, so the order cancelled immediately.
decision_style: walks to the cafe, looks at the menu board, and pays at the counter; will not order online under any circumstances.
voice: Rapid and informal, heavy with local slang ('ghost kitchens', 'corporate BS'); drops 'like' and 'totally' frequently.
